Companion Animal Travel Desk

Aurelia Skyways pet travel basics

Use the Companion Animal Travel Desk as soon as you arrive. The team checks papers, carrier fit, and the animal's comfort before the trip begins. Keep your pet calm, leash ready, and documents easy to reach.

<<FACT F069>> Bring the crate that matches the rules and make sure there is room for safe standing and turning. The staff will look at the carrier, the tags, and the condition of the door latch. If anything looks off, fix it before you move on.

<<FACT F079>> Keep the health paper with you and show it when asked. The desk checks that the record is current and clear, and the cabin team may review it again during boarding. Do not wait until the last minute.

<<FACT F063>> If your pet and crate are too heavy, you will need to adjust the plan before travel. Stay close to the counter, listen to the coordinator, and follow every update without delay.

For more help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
